local-exec.command: az aks get-credentials --resource-group Test-DataFabric --name golden-cluster --overwrite-existing && for i in $(seq 1 30); do kubelogin convert-kubeconfig -l azurecli >/dev/null 2>&1; kubectl auth can-i create deployments -n default >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 10; done; echo 'Cluster Admin RBAC did not propagate within 5 minutes' >&2; exit 1

azure_tofu-cluster-admin_49483F90.role_definition_name: Azure Kubernetes Service RBAC Cluster Admin

local-exec.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<'YAML'
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: ClusterIssuer
metadata:
  name: letsencrypt-prod
spec:
  acme:
    server: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory
    email: admin@polaris-azure.golden.example
    privateKeySecretRef:
      name: letsencrypt-prod
    solvers:
    - http01:
        ingress:
          class: nginx
YAML

command:
until curl -sfo /dev/null "$DISCOVERY_URL"; do
  echo "waiting for OIDC issuer $DISCOVERY_URL"
  sleep 5
done
echo "OIDC issuer reachable"
init_container.name: wait-for-issuer

local-exec.command: kubectl patch ingress polaris-ingress -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":[]}}' --type=merge || echo FAILED

command:
set -e
if [ -f /state/already-bootstrapped ]; then
  echo 'Polaris realm POLARIS already bootstrapped, skipping'
  exit 0
fi
java -jar /deployments/polaris-admin-tool.jar bootstrap -r POLARIS -c "POLARIS,$POLARIS_ID,$POLARIS_SECRET"
container.name: bootstrap

command:
set -e
until pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER"; do echo 'waiting for postgres'; sleep 2; done
psql -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='$POLARIS_DB'" | grep -q 1 \
  || psql -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE \"$POLARIS_DB\""
if [ "$(psql -d "$POLARIS_DB" -tAc "SELECT to_regclass('polaris_schema.entities')")" = 'polaris_schema.entities' ]; then
  touch /state/already-bootstrapped
fi
echo 'polaris db ready'
init_container.name: db-create

local-exec.command: kubectl delete statefulset emrys-master --force --grace-period=0 || echo FAILED
kubectl delete statefulset emrys-worker --force --grace-period=0 || echo FAILED
kubectl patch sparkclusters emrys  -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge || echo FAILED
kubectl patch sparkapplication spark-connector  -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge || echo FAILED
